reasoning: The evidence strongly indicates Israel will participate in Eurovision 2026. Multiple sources from January-February 2026 confirm: (1) Israel was officially drawn into the first semi-final on May 12, 2026 during the Vienna draw ceremony; (2) The EBU voted overwhelmingly against excluding Israel in December 2025; (3) Noam Bettan has been selected as Israel's representative with a song to be released March 5, 2026; (4) Israel is competing under its own flag, not a neutral flag. While five countries (Spain, Ireland, Iceland, Netherlands, Slovenia) are boycotting, Israel's participation is confirmed. The contest is still ~2 months away, but withdrawal at this stage would be highly unusual.
